name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.edgeRaw_labels
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (e : Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat),
  Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.edgeRaw g) e →
    LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.pc DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.natC e)
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.labelB g))

source.code:
theorem edgeRaw_labels (e : ℕ × ℕ) (he : e ∈ g.edgeRaw) : Network.pc natC e ≤ 2 * g.labelB := by
  unfold edgeRaw at he
  rw [List.mem_flatMap] at he
  obtain ⟨j, _, he⟩ := he
  rw [List.mem_map] at he
  obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := he
  apply g.pc_le_labelB
  · have := g.repOf_le_len a; dsimp only; omega
  · have := g.repOf_le_len j; dsimp only; omega
